config.model: sigma = sigma_JC(theta) * exp(delta), delta = 5-16-16-1 tanh correction network
config.source: User notebook pages and instructions, 7 November 2026 (Equation 1 of 'User-customised JC Equation')

variable_mapping.eps: E11, the monotonic axial strain coordinate (user-confirmed 7 Nov 2026)
variable_mapping.rate: matrix strain_rate in 1/s; ln term uses rate/rate0 (user-confirmed strain-rate ratio)
variable_mapping.Tstar: (T - T_ref)/(T_melt - T_ref) with matrix temperature in degrees C; clipped at 0 below T_ref
variable_mapping.G: matrix shear_modulus in MPa (G0 given in MPa by the user)
variable_mapping.phi: 1 - density/rho0 per case (user-confirmed 7 Nov 2026); 1 - phi = density/rho0
variable_mapping.B: reparametrised as B = A*beta/eps_ref^n with 0 <= beta <= 0.99 so A - B*eps^n > 0 for eps <= eps_ref

selection.score: 0.5*(case-CV mean curve RMSE + mean over the nine temperature/rate group holdouts of the group mean curve RMSE)
selection.tie_break: lowest score; exact ties prefer larger lambda_phys, then frozen theta

final.ensemble: geometric mean of member stresses, equal to sigma_JC(theta)*exp(mean delta) for frozen theta

study_point.note: phi = 4% is the user's study condition (rho = 2700*(1-0.04)); G uses the middle matrix level because the data cross G and density independently

development_notes: 7 Nov 2026, before the formal selection run and using the three training-case folds only (no group holdouts, no test data):

weight decay alpha=0.001 (inherited from the sklearn single MLP) let the multiplicative correction exp(delta) blow up when extrapolating (fold mean RMSE 25.3); alpha in {0.001,0.1,1,3,10} at lambda=0 gave 25.3/4.8/2.4/4.2/4.6, so alpha=1 is fixed
the level penalty pulled predictions toward Equation 1, which is about 10% off in level, and raised fold errors; a derivative (trend) residual was added as a second physics form
single-seed fold means: none 2.37, trend 1e-4/1e-3/1e-2/1e-1 2.75/3.18/2.82/4.13, level 1e-3/1e-2 4.97/4.08; joint theta was worse on the fold without 30C/1e-5 cases
these development looks use the same three folds as the formal case-CV, so the selected model's CV estimate is mildly optimistic

monotonicity.rule: Training pairs show stress falls with E11 (except case 60), falls with T, rises with G and with density (falls with porosity). Strain rate is mixed in the data, so it is not checked.

study_point.note: 300 C has no data: its curve follows Equation 1 through the physics term only and is unvalidated.

caveat: The 37 test cases were explored in earlier project stages, so this is not a blind test. Group-holdout errors were part of the selection score, so the selected model's group errors are optimistic. Stress units are inferred as MPa. No experimental validation; 300 C predictions are unvalidated.
